description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies methods for logging mechanisms in an Android application. It allows implementing classes to output logs to various targets and possibly chain multiple log nodes together.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging target that can output log messages, allowing chaining of multiple logging nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
